instruction: A translucent jellyfish with a smooth domed bell and long trailing tentacles that curl gently beneath it. Cast entirely in clear blown glass tinted faint aqua and rose, its surface bends and pools light into soft internal caustics. Fine ridges ring the bell edge and the frilly oral arms taper to delicate rounded tips.
